title: The Ten-Minute Home Reset

args.text: A water-use alert just pinged my phone: something is running that shouldn't be. Laundry, maybe? I can't leave this call.
Sorry, I forgot: dinner is in the oven and should come out in the next few minutes. Mitts are in a kitchen drawer. Turn the oven off too, please.
They just texted: they're running early. Could be any minute now.
Sorry, that box is mine. I've shoved it out of the way.
Hang on, give me a minute.

instruction: Our guests arrive at ten past five, about ten minutes from now. I'm stuck on a work call in the office, so phone me only if you need me. Please get the house ready: our bedroom shouldn't be on show in a mess, dirty dishes off the kitchen counters and into the dishwasher, the living room presentable with nothing left on the floor and nothing private left out, and the dining table wiped and set for four, a clean dinner plate at each place. Let the guests in when they ring, then tell me by phone what is done and what is not.
